title: Claude Feature 06: Type nahi, bol kar Claude se baat karo #shorts
description:
Claude Feature 06 (Claude for Everyone): voice mode. Chat box me sound wave icon par click karo (phone me mic ke paas), ek voice chuno aur bolna shuru karo. Hands-free mode default hai: Claude aapke rukne par jawab deta hai. Shor wali jagah push-to-talk chuno: button dabao aur bolo. Text aur voice ek hi chat me badal sakte ho. Non-English languages abhi beta me hain. Voice conversations regular usage limit me ginti hain, audio default me save nahi hota, sirf transcript chat history me rehta hai.

Source (official):
https://support.claude.com/en/articles/11101966-use-voice-mode

Unofficial channel, not affiliated with Anthropic.

Note: the docs crop is our own capture of the official help page (key line highlighted). The app screens are illustrations. Synthetic voice.

Music: "Funkorama" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com)
